1: # ArkTS Language Guide
2: 
3: ArkTS is a TypeScript superset optimized for HarmonyOS with strict static typing enforcement and UI declaration extensions.
4: 
5: ## Key Differences from TypeScript
6: 
7: ### Prohibited Features (Critical!)
8: 
9: ArkTS **strictly prohibits** these TypeScript features. Using them will cause **compilation errors**:
10: 
11: ```typescript
12: // ❌ These TypeScript features are NOT allowed in ArkTS
13: 
14: // 1. any type - ABSOLUTELY FORBIDDEN
15: let data: any;  // Compilation Error!
16: 
17: // 2. unknown type
18: let value: unknown;  // Error!
19: 
20: // 3. Type assertions
21: (value as string).length;  // Error!
22: (<SomeType>data).method();  // Error!
23: 
24: // 4. Dynamic property access (without Record type)
25: let obj = {};
26: obj['key'] = value;  // Error! (unless Record type)
27: 
28: // 5. Structural typing for classes
29: class A { x: number = 0; }
30: class B { x: number = 0; }
31: let a: A = new B();  // Error! Classes must be explicitly related
32: 
33: // 6. typeof for types
34: type T = typeof someVariable;  // Error!
35: 
36: // 7. keyof operator
37: type Keys = keyof SomeType;  // Error!
38: 
39: // 8. Indexed access types
40: type Value = SomeType['key'];  // Error!
41: 
42: // 9. Conditional types
43: type Check<T> = T extends string ? 'yes' : 'no';  // Error!
44: 
45: // 10. Mapped types
46: type Readonly<T> = { readonly [P in keyof T]: T[P] };  // Error!
47: 
48: // 11. Symbol type
49: const sym = Symbol('key');  // Error!
50: 
51: // 12. Decorators on non-class elements (except specific ArkTS decorators)
52: ```
53: 
54: ### Allowed Patterns (ArkTS-Specific)
55: 
56: ```typescript
57: // ✅ These patterns are supported and recommended
58: 
59: // 1. Explicit types
60: let data: string = 'hello';
61: let count: number = 42;
62: let flag: boolean = true;
63: 
64: // 2. Interfaces
65: interface User {
66:   id: string;
67:   name: string;
68:   age?: number;  // Optional properties OK
69: }
70: 
71: // 3. Type aliases (basic)
72: type UserId = string;
73: type Callback = (data: string) => void;
74: type Status = 'loading' | 'success' | 'error';  // Union types
75: 
76: // 4. Record type for dynamic keys
77: let map: Record<string, number> = {};
78: map['key1'] = 100;  // OK with Record type
79: 
80: // 5. Enums
81: enum Color {
82:   Red,
83:   Green,
84:   Blue
85: }
86: 
87: // 6. Class inheritance
88: class Animal {
89:   name: string = '';
90: }
91: 
92: class Dog extends Animal {
93:   breed: string = '';
94: }
95: 
96: // 7. Generics (basic)
97: class Container<T> {
98:   private value: T = {} as T;
99: 
100:   setValue(value: T): void {
101:     this.value = value;
102:   }
103: 
104:   getValue(): T {
105:     return this.value;
106:   }
107: }
108: ```
109: 
110: ## Type System
111: 
112: ### Primitive Types
113: 
114: ```typescript
115: // Numbers
116: let integer: number = 42;
117: let float: number = 3.14;
118: 
119: // Strings
120: let text: string = 'Hello';
121: let template: string = `Value: ${integer}`;  // Template literals
122: 
123: // Booleans
124: let flag: boolean = true;
125: 
126: // Arrays
127: let numbers: number[] = [1, 2, 3];
128: let strings: Array<string> = ['a', 'b', 'c'];
129: 
130: // Tuples
131: let tuple: [string, number] = ['age', 25];
132: 
133: // Null and undefined (with unions)
134: let nullable: string | null = null;
135: let optional: string | undefined = undefined;
136: 
137: // Resource types (HarmonyOS-specific)
138: let icon: Resource = $r('app.media.icon');
139: let color: Resource = $r('app.color.primary');
140: let string: ResourceStr = $r('app.string.app_name');
141: ```
142: 
143: ### Object Types
144: 
145: ```typescript
146: // Interface (preferred)
147: interface Product {
148:   readonly id: string;  // Read-only
149:   name: string;
150:   price: number;
151:   description?: string;  // Optional
152:   tags?: string[];
153: }
154: 
155: // Implementation
156: const product: Product = {

183:

185: // Function declarations
186: function add(a: number, b: number): number {
187:   return a + b;
188: }
189: 
190: // Arrow functions

192: 
193: // Optional parameters

196: }

222: 
223: ### Generics
224: 
225: ```typescript
226: // Generic function
227: function identity<T>(value: T): T {
228:   return value;
229: }
230: 
231: // With constraints
232: interface HasId {
233:   id: string;
234: }
235: 
236: function findById<T extends HasId>(items: T[], id: string): T | undefined {
237:   return items.find(item => item.id === id);
238: }

240: // Generic interface

245: }

273: ```
274: 
275: ## Classes
276: 
277: ### Class Declaration
278:

281:   // Properties MUST have default values (strict requirement)
282:   private id: string = '';
283:   public name: string = '';
284:   protected email: string = '';
285:   readonly createdAt: Date = new Date();
